title: Section Title (Left)
description: The left-aligned variant of Section Title, matching the live `.lsx-title.lsx-title-left:after` rule, which swaps the gold rule's `margin: 8px auto` for `margin: 8px 0` so it sits flush with the text rather than centred. Used where a section header shares a row with body copy or a card, as on the accommodation and tour singles. The rule is drawn in assets/styles/core-heading.css.
